name: Bugs board
author: Brett
description: The confirmed bugs list (bugs@1, kept next to the builds store and published to main like the builds): drag and drop to set priority and to move bugs between builds, each build with its live state (running with agent and step x/y, queued with its place in the agent-slot line, built with PR, merged), Unassigned on its own. Moving a bug into a build adds an addendum and a 'Fix bug' step there, tells its running session and posts the handoff in the crew group chat, where the build's agent takes it or bounces it to the next best build (or to Brett). Auto-optimize switch (default off, zero tokens) matches unassigned bugs to queued or running builds by app, area and files with a preview and Undo. Bugs on a build whose PR merges are marked fixed. Lazy-loaded board, banner count, context menu on every bug. REST, MCP (bugs_list, bug_add, bug_update, bug_move, bug_reorder, bugs_optimize) and CLI (bugs.mjs).

keeps: _claude/builds/bugs.json (bugs@1): the bugs list lives next to the builds store and on main, like the builds; delete it there by hand if the list is no longer wanted
